readout_other: Novel object texture discrimination; T-maze; two-photon calcium imaging of layer 5 pyramidal neurons; dendritic spine imaging; local field potential
direction_notes: Seven days of TUS improved memory behaviour in VD mice, increased barrel cortex pyramidal neuron calcium activity and spine formation, and reduced spine elimination; effects lasted 7 days after TUS but not 14 days, and a second TUS course after 28 days did not restore them.

exposures.label: TUS of the barrel cortex in VD mice

timing.protocol_description: 50,000-cycle pulses at 1 MHz (5% duty cycle, 1 Hz PRF); stimulation daily for 7 consecutive days as three blocks of 25 min separated by 5 min breaks.

exposures.label: TUS of the visual cortex in VD mice (control site)

timing.protocol_description: 50,000-cycle pulses at 1 MHz (5% duty cycle, 1 Hz PRF); stimulation daily for 7 consecutive days as three blocks of 25 min separated by 5 min breaks.

source_quotes.n_subjects: These transgenic mice were divided into five groups (sham, VD, VD+TUS (visual cortex + TUS and barrel cortex + TUS), VD+Trapezoidal pulse) with 10 mice per group (five GCaMP6f and five Thy1-YFP-H).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The VD+TUS, and VD+Trapezoidal pulse groups underwent TUS stimulation for 7 consecutive days after establishing the ischemia model.

flags.reason: 50 mice enrolled in five groups of 10 (sham, VD, VD+TUS barrel and visual cortex, VD+trapezoidal); includes groups that received no ultrasound, and exposed total is not stated.
Seven consecutive days; each day had three 25 min blocks.
Pulse duration not stated as such; paper gives 50,000 cycles at 1 MHz and 'stimulation time = 50 ms', which with 5% DC at 1 Hz PRF matches a 50 ms pulse (resolved by arithmetic).
'a total of three groups of 25 min' read as three 25 min blocks of repeated pulses; may alternatively mean 25 min in total.
0.2 MPa given without stating water or in-brain; sound field was simulated in COMSOL but no in-brain values reported.
Visual cortex TUS (control site) described only in the limitations section, with the same parameters; results in a supplementary figure.
Trapezoidal-pulse VD+TUS group used to test for auditory effects, recorded as ramped_pulses.
Sham and VD groups received no ultrasound; visual cortex TUS served as an active control site.
Mice awake during imaging; state during sonication not stated.
Local field potential recording reported in the limitations section (supplementary figure).
